scope: isolated real TLS HTTP/1.1; synthetic data; shared SATA SSD except explicitly marked tmpfs; fsync enabled; no concurrent builds/tests/profiles; production unchanged

goal.definition: same adopted version, median of 3 standard 10s arrival-window trials at each CPU quota; 4GiB, 80 actors, 16 threads, planned 800 posts/s; neither stable capacity nor comparison with old 2CPU

limitations: all adopted arrival-window trials stable_at_tested_rate=false; planned load was partly unissued
shared host and SSD variability; no guaranteed fixed throughput or speedup
startup of first adopted 300/s 60s trial exceeded default 60s; fresh retry with 180s wait verified DAT/ETag at about78s; original deadline still missed
SIGKILL DAT/ETag recovery passed but about5.30s missed5s; no power-loss/media-failure proof
long histories, long term load, WAN/NIC, real browser/device, production rollout unverified
intermediate image tags containing final are not adopted; adopted tag is reviewed

profiles.note: different profile intervals and startup/load mix; do not compare percentages as a fixed speedup
different profile intervals and startup/load mix; do not compare percentages as a fixed speedup
